words.word: upon him while he is weary

occurrences.text: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
words: upon him while he is weary

occurrences.text: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
